lines.zh: 我拖着半截身体，一步一步碾过去。
lines.en: I drag my half-formed body forward, step by step.

lines.zh: 脚落地时，尘土先跳起来。
lines.en: When my foot lands, the dust jumps first.
I cannot fly; these legs must carry me.

lines.zh: 这具身体还没长全，走起来发沉。
lines.en: This body is unfinished and heavy to walk in.

lines.zh: 树被我肩膀一擦就折了。
lines.en: Trees snap where my shoulder brushes them.

lines.zh: 地面在我脚下响，像要裂。
lines.en: The ground groans under me as if about to split.

lines.zh: 十二格高，走一步顶你十步。
lines.en: Twelve blocks tall: one step of mine is ten of yours.

lines.zh: 我听见自己的骨头在互相磨。
lines.en: I hear my own bones grinding together.

lines.zh: 气在我身体里滚，找不到出口。
lines.en: Ki churns inside me with no way out.
My tail passes and the shrubs are gone.
I do not look for a path; I crush one.
I stand still, and my body keeps growing.

lines.zh: 半截的形态，呼吸都漏风。
lines.en: Half-formed as I am, my breath leaks out.
Light shows through beneath my skin.

lines.zh: 我不明白自己缺了什么。
lines.en: I do not understand what I am missing.
The air here is too light.
I clench a fist and the knuckles crack.

lines.zh: 我低头看自己的手，很陌生。
lines.en: I look at my own hand; it is unfamiliar.

lines.zh: 安静时，我听见体内的回声。
lines.en: In the quiet I hear an echo inside me.
I wait for this body to finish.

lines.zh: 风撞在我身上，绕开走了。
lines.en: The wind hits me and goes around.
Only one of my eyes sees clearly.
This hate grew before the body did.

lines.zh: 我的影子在晃，像还没定形。
lines.en: My shadow wavers, not yet settled.
Standing too long sinks my feet into soil.
You are shorter than one of my feet.
I recognize the ki in your hands.

lines.zh: 别离太近，我踩下去不收脚。
lines.en: Not so close; I do not stop my steps.

lines.zh: 你是来封我的，还是来送死的。
lines.en: Did you come to seal me, or to die?

lines.zh: 我动了动脖子，骨头在响。
lines.en: I shift my neck and the bones crack.

lines.zh: 你身上没有封印的味道。
lines.en: You do not smell of the seal.

lines.zh: 我不需要理由，只需要目标。
lines.en: I need no reason, only a target.

lines.zh: 我还没长完，但够打你了。
lines.en: I am not finished, but finished enough for you.

lines.zh: 你站着不动，是在计算什么。
lines.en: Standing still — what are you calculating?
One step brings me to you.
Do not point at me.

lines.zh: 我也许该先拆了你的房子。
lines.en: Perhaps I should take your house apart first.

lines.zh: 你看我的眼神，像看过我。
lines.en: You look at me as if you have seen me before.
This body dislikes being watched.
I raise my hand and your sky darkens.
You took three steps back. Noted.

lines.zh: 这么小的伤，也敢留在我身上。
lines.en: Such a small wound dares to stay on me.
I feel no pain, only annoyance.

lines.zh: 皮还没硬，被你钻了空子。
lines.en: My hide is not set; you found a gap.

lines.zh: 我吼出来，气从伤口漏了。
lines.en: I roar, and ki leaks from the wound.

lines.zh: 我自己都不知道该捂哪里。
lines.en: I do not even know where to hold myself.

lines.zh: 这一下，让我身体又歪了一分。
lines.en: That knocked my body another degree askew.
You struck into the seam of my bones.
I stand and do not retreat.

lines.zh: 三百点生命，够你打很久。
lines.en: Three hundred health will keep you busy.
Your ki is weak, but accurate.
I take in only ki and hate.

lines.zh: 这堆东西，连我一口都不够。
lines.en: This pile is not one mouthful for me.

lines.zh: 你把食物举给一个怪物看。
lines.en: You show food to a monster.
I do not eat. I dismantle.
Energy, maybe. Food, no.

lines.zh: 你要是带气来，我倒想要。
lines.en: Bring ki and I might want it.
I do not need feeding.
Stop waving it; my head spins.
The smell only makes me want to break things.
Holding that makes you look even smaller.

lines.zh: 我被撞的那块皮肤，还是软的。
lines.en: The patch you hit is still soft.
Move; my foot is coming down.

lines.zh: 我们之间不适合这么近。
lines.en: This is too close for us.
That bounce threw you clear.

lines.zh: 我的身体还没硬，撞着也疼。
lines.en: My hide is not set; that hurt too.
Trees make more noise than that.
Do not walk against my leg.

lines.zh: 地面被我们挤出一道沟。
lines.en: Our weight cuts a ditch in the ground.
Again, and I will pin you down.

lines.zh: 这种话，对一个半成品说？
lines.en: You say this to something unfinished?
I am not even fully grown.
Hirudegarn needs no kin.
Only ki churns inside me.
Do not say such things at my feet.
I asked once. No one answered.

lines.zh: 翼还没长出来，谈什么配对。
lines.en: My wings have not grown; what pairing?

lines.zh: 这具身体连温度都没有。
lines.en: This body does not even have warmth.
Leave; I am not in the mood.
I hate more than I want.

lines.zh: 我抓起一棵树，根还带着土。
lines.en: I grab a tree, roots and soil still attached.
This is too light in my hand.
I crush it to see what is inside.
A small piece of iron. Useless.

lines.zh: 我拾起一块岩石，准备扔出去。
lines.en: I pick up a rock to throw.

lines.zh: 它滑掉了，我手上还沾着土。
lines.en: It slipped; my hand is still muddy.
I keep it. It may be good for throwing.
A ki blast leaks between my fingers.
These are not worth bending for.
I pick it up, then slowly let go.
You moved. It is that simple.
Ki gathers into a small sphere in my palm.
Twelve blocks tall—one step spans it.

lines.zh: 我不需要预判，你跑不快。
lines.en: I need no prediction; you cannot run fast.
I know what is behind you.
My body is heating up.
Whoever looks up is the target.
Do not think trees will block me.

lines.zh: 我抓了一把土，先扔过去。
lines.en: I scoop soil and throw it first.
You standing your ground only provokes me.

lines.zh: 锁骨的声音，你听见了吗。
lines.en: Did you hear my collarbone shift?
I have decided.
The blast has already left my hand.
Target locked, no further changes.
You change direction; I change course.
I cannot fly, but I do not stop.
Your ki runs ahead, hurried.

lines.zh: 墙挡在我前面，我拆了它。
lines.en: A wall stands before me; I take it apart.
You glanced back. I am still here.
The blast I threw is chasing you.
Your speed is dropping.

lines.zh: 我的巨猿光束正在聚集。
lines.en: My ape beam is gathering.

lines.zh: 这一带的地形，我记住了。
lines.en: I have memorized this terrain.

lines.zh: 你踩着石头跳，很好的落点。
lines.en: You leap off that stone — a good landing spot.
I expect you to go left.

lines.zh: 你越跑越靠近我的脚印。
lines.en: The further you run, the closer you come to my footprints.
I do not need to see; I can hear.

lines.zh: 再往前，就是我自己踩出的坑。
lines.en: Ahead lies the crater I made.
I do not shout; it burns ki.
You stopped. Why.

lines.zh: 我一拳砸下去，土都立起来。
lines.en: My fist comes down and the soil stands up.
This palm seals your path.

lines.zh: 十五点伤害，我只用了三分力。
lines.en: Fifteen damage, at three-tenths effort.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的腿，往树上甩。
lines.en: I catch your leg and hurl you at a tree.
My knee drives down; the ground gives out.
You were slapped into the dirt.
My tail comes faster than my fist.
I stomp, and only your shadow is left.
This blow is not to kill you.

lines.zh: 我还没长完全，力气已经够了。
lines.en: I am unfinished, and already strong enough.
I raise my hand and there is shadow.
It comes down without a sound.

lines.zh: 我呼出一口气，把你吹开。
lines.en: I exhale and blow you back.

lines.zh: 封印裂开时，我只出来一半。
lines.en: When the seal split, only half of me came out.
My body is still growing out of the ground.
My first breath was soil.

lines.zh: 我站起来，肩膀穿过树冠。
lines.en: I stand, and my shoulders pass through the canopy.

lines.zh: 骨头在响，一节接着一节。
lines.en: Bones crack, joint after joint.

lines.zh: 我不知道自己缺了什么。
lines.en: I do not know what I am missing.

lines.zh: 脚下这片地，很快就碎了。
lines.en: The ground here breaks quickly.
I pull my legs from the soil. Heavy.
For a moment I block the sun.

lines.zh: 我张开手，掌心还是没有光。
lines.en: I open my hand; still no light in the palm.
They call this the incomplete form. I know.

lines.zh: 四周的树都朝我倒过来。
lines.en: The trees around me lean away.

lines.zh: 第一个看见我的人，会记住。
lines.en: The first to see me will remember.

lines.zh: 我想起自己被关了很久。
lines.en: I remember being shut away a long time.

lines.zh: 十二格高，地却比我还低。
lines.en: Twelve blocks tall, and the land is still lower.

lines.zh: 我的翼根鼓起来，却长不出翼。
lines.en: My wing roots swell but no wings come.
First stand firm; the rest can wait.
Fire burns on my hide and will not go out.

lines.zh: 我从高处落地，砸进土里。
lines.en: I land from a height and sink into the soil.

lines.zh: 水灌进来，我的身体在变重。
lines.en: Water floods in and my body grows heavy.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我半边身体震得发麻。
lines.en: The blast numbs half of my body.

lines.zh: 有小东西扎进我的皮里。
lines.en: Something small has lodged in my hide.

lines.zh: 封印的余威压下来，我的身体一缩。
lines.en: The seal's residue presses and my body flinches.

lines.zh: 气在流失，这躯体开始缩小。
lines.en: Ki is leaking and this body begins to shrink.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我的骨头都亮了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and my bones light up.

lines.zh: 脚下没有土，我的腿在空中乱抓。
lines.en: No soil below; my legs claw at air.
